answer: Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the dune of a task receipt, and the kernel is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
